title: [AI] Keep split child fields when updating a transaction through the API
issueTitle: [Bug]: Calling API updateTransaction for a sub-transaction clears the category & amount
why: The bug only shows up when the @actual-app/api Node package calls updateTransaction on a sub-transaction, and the report never says that editing a split's notes in the browser UI causes it, so a UI-only test can't reliably reproduce it.
